text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: inference-prod-eu - request queue depth > 95th pctile for 60s. paging oncall. severity: P1. Links: https://infra.redwood/status/1964123456

Ava: acked and joining bridge. taking lead.

Ben: on my way. quick question — any customer-facing 5xx spike yet?

ops-bot: customer-errors (5xx) increased 4x for /v1/generate (eu region) during window 1964123300-1964123400. 503 spikes correlate with KV-cache eviction errors.

Ava: mitigation plan: 1) scale dedicated-gpu-pool-eu by +2 nodes 2) force fallback to quantized-variant for heavy-rerank (route: /v1/rerank) 3) enable strict-prefix-caching for frequent prefixes. executing now.

Samir: deploying scale up via infra-cli: ```
# scale pool
infra-cli pools scale --name dedicated-gpu-pool-eu --delta 2
# force variant
rbac deploy-config set inference.routing.model_fallback = "quantized-small"
```

Ava: scaled. observing reduced queue depth in ~30s. still seeing intermittent 503s on /v1/rerank.

Priya: from product side: are users losing sessions or seeing partial responses? need ask CS for immediate customer impact summary.

Marco: CS report: 24 tickets opened in last 45m, top complaints are "no response" and "slow AI suggestions". estimated impacted orgs: ~7 paying customers experiencing degraded UX. no revenue-impacting outage reported yet.

Ben: quick root hypothesis: large rerank jobs were not being batched properly, causing KV cache thrash and eviction storm. fallback helped but alert still noisy because it fires on queue > threshold for any worker. we should scope to per-route or per-model.

Ava: agreed. for now setting a temporary suppress rule to avoid paging on low-impact routes. ```
# temporary alert mute
alerts mute --id alert-queue-deep --scope route:/v1/embed --until 1964127600
```

Priya: thanks. can we capture a timeline + customer impact, then schedule post-incident review? prefer tomorrow EOD.

Ben: creating quick mitigation checklist and action items in thread. items: 1) postmortem doc 2) alert rule refinement 3) SLO recalculation for rerank vs gen 4) evaluate KV cache size / eviction policy 5) add better route-level batching metrics

Ava: assigning owners here: postmortem doc -> Ben, alert rule refinement -> Samir, SLO recalculation -> Priya + Product metrics, KV cache investigation -> Marco, batching metrics -> Ava. target delivery: 72h for triage + 10 business days for full remediations.

Samir: quick note on alert refinement idea: instead of queue depth global, switch to a composite that includes "queue growth rate" OR "per-route 99th latency". sample rule (Datadog-like): ```
alert:
  name: inference_queue_sustained_growth
  expr: (avg_over_time(queue_depth[2m]) > 80) AND (increase(queue_depth[2m]) > 20)
  scope: service:inference,region:eu
  for: 2m
  notify: oncall
```

Ben: also propose adding a low-noise pager tier: page only when (a) customer-facing errors > X AND (b) queue depth sustained + autoscaler failing to respond. everything else goes to alert channel for SRE review.

Priya: +1. Product will help define what X is — we want to avoid paging for transient blips. Priya-> will pull historical incidents to find thresholds.

Marco: small ops followup: add a hard guard to prevent single route consuming >70% of pool tokens — helps avoid noisy single-tenant storms. creating RFC.

Ava: scheduling postmortem review: proposed slot Thu 15:00 UTC (calendar invite sent). draft doc link: https://docs.redwood/pmr/1964123456 (Ben, please own initial writeup).

Ben: started doc with timeline + logs snippet. will add ATDDs and initial RCA.

Samir: created ticket INF-4312 for alert rule change; linking here.

Priya: CS followup — we'll loop in account leads for the 7 impacted customers and offer status update. tagging Marco for customer-facing writeup.

Ava: action items recap (short):
- Ben: draft postmortem doc + timeline (due: +24h)
- Samir: refine alerts (prototype + deploy) (due: +72h)
- Priya: compute SLO threshold suggestions and historical analysis (due: +72h)
- Marco: KV cache investigation + RFC for per-tenant guard (due: +5d)
- Ava: add batching telemetry dashboards and follow-through (due: +7d)

Ben: adding labels: severity:P1, impact:partial, customers:7, owner:Ava.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: queue depth back to baseline, traffic normalized. incident moved to post-incident state.

Priya: thanks everyone. please update assigned tickets with notes. we'll review in Thu postmortem.

Ava: closing on-call bridge. leaving followups in thread. :thumbsup:
